Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's Ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, succeeding Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit and handing over to K. P. S. Menon in 1952. The team note that Pandit held the post from 1949 to 1952 is wrong: she was in Moscow from 1947 to 1949 and then moved to Washington. I haven't re-checked these dates against a source in this turn.

CONFIDENCE: 90
